method.timestamp_handling: Sources explicitly touched after each archive; grit-lib, grit-cli and grit-utils recompiled. External dependencies use the identical Cargo.lock.
method.direct: 600 measured samples per executable, 20 warmups, deterministic randomized tool order each round, perf_counter_ns around subprocess.run, stdout discarded
method.related: 120 samples per tool/scenario, randomized tool order each round; mutation refs reset outside timed region; matched grit-bench helpers for rename and merged-ref
method.rss: 20 additional /usr/bin/time -v samples per tool/scenario, randomized order each round; statistic is median of maximum RSS
method.daily: Two 20-sample batches per revision, revision order before/after/after/before; pooled daily baselines include Git from each respective runner
method.hyperfine: --shell=none --warmup 20 --runs 300 in each command order, 600 total per executable
method.caveat: Different CPU from the review (EPYC 9V45 vs EPYC 7763). Same-path builds favor the patch here; this does not establish the cause of the reviewer's contrary result.

profiling.perf: cpu-clock:u at 3999 Hz with DWARF stacks, 400 commands per revision; malloc/free and process/config setup remain visible. These profiles are not used for wall-time comparisons.
